verifiedCheckpoint.name: EXISTING-CLIENT-PROJECT-CREATION-GREEN
verifiedCheckpoint.meaning: The behavior-traced existing-Client Project creation workflow passed independent review and all exact-commit CI jobs, including traceability, disposable local Supabase, the full isolated target suite, and macOS/iOS builds; O-026 still blocks final cutover authorization.

activeWorkflow.outcome: Toggle one represented checklist item in an active Project or Business Inventory Space with immediate optimistic progress, durable offline acceptance, deterministic replay, rejection recovery, and authoritative readback.
nextActions: Implement the trusted transactional Supabase checklist-replacement handler with explicit grants, RLS-compatible authorization, idempotency, concurrency, and negative tests.
Implement the encrypted PowerSync checklist operation, optimistic overlay, upload/result reconciliation, restart/replay, rejection, and runtime drainage.
Compose the active-only checklist toggle through the existing exact-Space detail AppModel and SwiftUI with honest pending, rejected, incomplete, empty, and archived states.
Independently review the integrated security/offline/UI diff, run one complete local gate, and verify one automatic exact-commit CI run.

progress.note: Workflow counts measure product progress. The surface catalog is a passive completeness audit, not a completion percentage.

blockers: A canonical production export or approved read-only access is required for production-profile and migration evidence.
Hosted Supabase and PowerSync resources, credentials, spending, and authenticated rehearsal require explicit user authorization.
O-026 must be approved before Project creation can be cutover-ready because its final project-budget command authorization, RLS, and Sync policy remain provisional.
A-003 and A-004 remain proposed until the complete vertical-spike exit gate passes.
guardrails: Do not implement redesigned behavior in Firebase.
Do not access or mutate production systems or production data.
Do not create paid or hosted resources, migrate data, freeze Firebase, release, or cut over without explicit user approval.

resume.instruction: Continue the active workflow from nextActions. Load only its named authority sections and affected code until a concrete discrepancy requires broader history.
